paper_b.title: Broken Replica Symmetry Bounds in the Mean Field Spin Glass Model (Guerra, 2002)

metadata.description: Registry mismatch: paper331.json's actual content is Trnková's 'Quasiorders on Topological Categories' (categorical/general topology — representing quasiorders by clopen and closed subspaces of metrizable spaces), not Talagrand's Parisi formula paper. paper332 is Guerra's broken-replica-symmetry interpolation bound for the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick mean field spin glass, proving N^{-1} E log Z_N <= bar-alpha(beta,h;x) via a single-parameter Gaussian interpolation and a positive sum rule on overlap variances. The two graphs share zero mathematical objects, methods, definitions, or theorems: one is general-topology / category theory of order representations, the other is rigorous statistical mechanics of disordered Ising spins. The hypothesised 'AP' relation (both proving the Parisi formula) cannot be substantiated against the actual paper331 content. All paper-origin Level-1 nodes from both sides are reported as 'none'.

matches.explanation: Trnková's definition of a quasiorder induced by a class of morphisms on a category has no analogue in Guerra's spin-glass paper, which contains no categorical or order-theoretic structures of this kind.
The notion of an M-representation of a quasiordered set in a category is purely category-theoretic; Guerra's paper involves no representation of orders by objects under morphism existence.
Auxiliary partial order combining strict <_1 with reverse <_2 is paper-internal scaffolding for Trnková's construction, with no counterpart in Guerra.
Components of the auxiliary order in Q have no analogue in Guerra.
